pages.text: Through the Electric Mending mutation, the Ravenous Maw learns to feast upon pure current rather than matter. This evolution allows the beast to siphon Forge Energy (FE), knitting its own wounds through galvanic consumption.

The Maw can store a reserve of FE that grows with each Stage (5,000 at Latent, up to 40,000 at Excelsior), burning through this charge to restore its durability. Furthermore, this raw static potential generates a magnetic vortex, dragging nearby items into its grasp faster with each higher Stage.

Such hunger is never idle. Each blow the beast delivers is paid for in current, and a Maw left dry strikes as a starving thing would: feebly, with barely a tenth of its fury, while it chimes a plaintive warning. Only the bolts of Iris Out are spared this toll.

Should the Maw also bear Undying Flesh, there is no wound left to knit, and the current has no wish to sleep. It turns outward. The beast is never weakened for want of charge, and every blow it can pay for lets the stolen lightning leap from the victim to as many as three lesser creatures crowded close by. When the reserve runs dry, the blow lands plain and silent.

Instability (Electroactivity): The current coursing through the Maw is volatile and untamed. Immersion in water invites disaster; the pent-up energy may occasionally ground itself through the wielder, inflicting a violent electrocution upon contact with the liquid.
